title: Could do with a free version
body: Seems like it could be good but it would be awesome to have a free version of this so people could try it out before having to pay. I’m definitely not paying for an app that has a high chance of ending up like every other unused “life changing” app out there.
author: Crazyclimber4444

title: Can’t use the app unless you subscribe
body: When you download the app it makes you go through all the hassle of doing a quiz and answering all these questions- just to take you to a paywall and if you exit out of it you still can’t access the app.
author: Chickenwingchickchick
